The documents encode protocol ownership, inspect/trace/control separation, privacy and untrusted-observation constraints, the post-initial-commit isolated worktree lifecycle, the unborn shared-checkout exception, independent review plus CI, and required bitty-docs synchronization. No product code or remote mutation was introduced.
